title: Groepe – Kruispad Hazeldean Gemeente
headings: h2:Eleos | h2:ELEOS was birthed out of a desire, to effect tangible change, in the lives of those living in poverty. ELEOS is named after a Greek term, which means “Mercy in Action”. ELEOS is a registered, non‐profit organisation which aims to deliver social services to underprivileged children and their families in Pretoria‐West. The people of this community not only struggle to obtain the bare essentials but are also burdened with enormous financial, physical, emotional and mental stresses. | h1:Eleos | h3:Kairos | h2:Kairos | h2:KAIROS originated as a result of an eye surgeon that did an operation on a learner from Laerskool Generaal Nicolaas Smit. The surgeon put it into words by saying: “We must thank GOD for this and that HE deserves all the glory as this was a KAIROS moment where GOD touched lives and changed them forever.” This is how God uses normal people to be disciples (Good Samaritans) that will pick up the poor, the broken and the lost so they can make a lasting change in the lives of someone else. Luke 10:25. | h2:KAIROS has different projects but our Primary purpose is not only to change a life but a whole posterity! | h2:KAIROS supports children from pre-school, primary school and high school to develop their full potential. Poverty can only be broken by education and qualifications (Tertiary education as well as trades are being sponsored!) | h2:Some of these learners attend schools in the East of Pretoria that has hostels where the circumstances are much better for them to achieve. We also placed learners in schools with hostels such as Delmas. The cost for this is enormous and is about R3500.00 per month per child then we also try to give them some pocket money so they can also feel that they fit into the mainstream with other children. Currently we have 3 primary school and five high school learners in hostels. We also sponsor +-15 other learners in our community on a regular basis. We also have students that we support with handbooks, clothing, transport etc. | h2:Parents are unemployed and KAIROS try to change this by doing skills audits and keeping record of this so that the whole family can benefit from this. Parents are placed at schools, industries, small and large companies on a voluntarily basis so we can see what they can do. Once they proof that they are trustworthy they receive a reference letter and are added to our data base for approved employees that provides more security to potential employers. | h2:KAIROS has become a beacon of hope to a large part of the community in a very short time. Schools, churches and other welfare organisations ask for help daily as poverty literally increases over night. Sometimes we have parents that work only so they can have a roof over their heads, but they can’t even afford to buy bread. We currently assist between 160 to 200 families with food parcels.

title: Eleos – Kruispad Hazeldean Gemeente
headings: h2:Eleos is a registered PBO & NPO. | h2:We help underprivileged children and their families in the Pretoria West region. | h2:Eleos has been supporting families in Pretoria West through various life transitions, since 1998.We do this by building personal relationships in all our group projects. | h2:We focus our work in Booysens and Claremont, Pretoria West. The people of this community not only struggle to obtain the bare essentials, but are also burdened with enormous financial, physical, emotional and mental challenges. | h2:Eleos builds relationships, regardless of race and culture. Eleos is a faith-based NPO, and therefore upholds Christian values.We focus on prevention, primary care and community upliftment. | h2:Eleos is a Greek word that means MERCY IN ACTION and that is what a group of women from Pretoria East started doing. | h2:During August 1998, a group of women visited a playgroup in Booysens. The desperate need and struggle of the children, touched the women in such a way, that they immediately decided to get actively involved. They not only realised how many families lived in dire need of basic essentials, but that social upliftment and ongoing projects were needed to make a difference in the children’s lives. Over the years, various community projects were launched, focussing on the family as a whole. A Community Centre in Wilhelm Street and an Early Childhood Development Centre in Market Street soon became beacons of hope for many destitute families. Eleos also has two After School Care facilities in close vicinity to the primary schools. | h2:We uphold Christian believes and values.

title: Kairos – Kruispad Hazeldean Gemeente
headings: h4:Meer oor Kairos | h2:In Efesiers 5:16 beteken Kairos “Maak die beste gebruik van elke geleentheid” om dit verder te verduidelik beteken dit Tydig, Betyds, ‘n Spesifieke seisoen. | h2:Deur die jare het die nood soveel toegeneem, dat ons besluit het om ‘n onafhanklike NPO op die been te bring. Kairos “Verander Lewens” is geinspireer deur Dr. Gideon Du Plessis nadat hy sy hart oopgemaak het vir ‘n kind met ‘n oog probleem. Die verandering wat sy onbaatsugtige hulp aan hierdie kind se lewe gemaak het kan aan niemand beskryf word nie. | h2:Dit is by hom waar ons geleer het wat Kairos werklik beteken. In Efesiers 5:16 beteken Kairos “Maak die beste gebruik van elke geleentheid” om dit verder te verduidelik beteken dit Tydig, Betyds, ‘n Spesifieke seisoen. Dr. Du Plessis het betyds in hierdie kind se lewe gekom en dit vir altyd ten goede verander. Dit het ons laat besef dat as net een mens ‘n kind se lewe so dramaties kan verander sal ons as ons net so ‘n bietjie van ons tyd en liefde gee soveel meer mense help en bereik.
